title: Quirk Skill Portability Matrix
description: Portable compatibility matrix for one bundle skill: which frontmatter fields travel across agent harnesses, which are runtime-specific, and whether the skill stays harness-safe.

skill.description: Bundle skill identity as <domain>/<skill> (for example delivery/review-pr).

portable.description: Frontmatter field names that carry the same meaning in every agent harness, per the Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io).

runtimeSpecific.description: Frontmatter field names that only one runtime interprets, keyed by runtime name.

claude-code.description: Fields consumed by the Claude Code harness (clauses, reloadPolicy, compatibility, approvalFor).

quirk.description: Fields consumed by the quirk bundle runtime (fixturesPath, evaluators, maxIterations, maturity, diataxis).

openai-agents.description: Fields consumed by an OpenAI Agents style runtime; empty when the skill declares none.

mcp.description: Fields consumed when the skill is exposed over the Model Context Protocol; empty when the skill declares none.

harnessSafe.description: True when the skill keeps a well-defined contract after the runtime-specific fields are stripped.

unknownFields.description: Frontmatter field names recognized by no group; decoration that a portable consumer must ignore.
